content.title: Reality star abruptly drops out of Unwell Winter Games forcing VERY unusual, last-minute casting change
content.text: A REALITY star unexpectedly dropping out of the Unwell Winter Games is forcing a very unusual last-minute casting change. Alex Cooper’s new competition reality show featuring the most controversial reality TV stars and influencers premiered on Monday – but had one big hitch. Sign up for the Entertainment newsletter Thank you! Alex Cooper’s new competition show premiered on YouTube MondayCredit: YouTube/Unwell Alex Cooper’s new competition show features controversial influencers and reality stars – including Ekin-Su Cülcüloğlu, Anna Delvey, and Saraya Bevis (pictured left to right)Credit: YouTube/Unwell A last-minute change forced Alex to make an unexpected casting choiceCredit: YouTube/Unwell Shortly before the first competition began, the contestants were informed that Kendall Washington from season 6 of Love Island USA would not be making it. “We had a fellow competitor miss a flight, but we have a replacement, and you guys are going to be excited,” host Adam Waheed said. The show then cuts to a producer informing Alex that Kendall can’t join the show. “I think we literally need to pull someone from production,” Alex said, before pointing out Unwell producer Andrew Vetter. “He’s got a mullet, and the girls may potentially love it,” she added. Alex invites Andrew to be on the show, and he accepts. “I swore I’d never be on reality TV,” Andrew told her. Andrew teamed up with influencer Hallie Batchelder for the show’s first challenge, which involved driving a snowmobile and guessing the other contestants’ follower counts. Most read in TV Even though Adam revealed that Andrew only had 300 followers, the other cast members immediately warmed up to him. “Something about Andrew’s haircut, and that one earring, just really made me feel something inside,” Hallie said. “We made eye contact, like we eye-f**ked a little bit.” Despite Andrew’s unusual casting, he’s shaping up to be the least controversial contestant on the show. The cast includes two contentious Mormon Wives castmembers, Dakota Mortensen and Demi Engemann. Dakota has already been edited out of his stint on Vanderpump Villa following allegations of domestic violence from his ex, Taylor Frankie Paul. Filming of Mormon Wives was temporarily paused due to the incident between Taylor and Dakota, which is still under investigation by police. Love Island USA breakout star Huda Mustafa and her boyfriend, former Too Hot to Handle contestant Louis Russell are also appearing on the Unwell Games together. The mother of Louis’ child currently has a restraining order against Huda. She alleges that Huda tried to break into her home and threatened her and her children. Along with being hosted by Adam, a comedian, the social media personalities Grace O’Malley and Graydon Cutler provide additional commentary. By the end of the episode, Kendall still hadn’t shown up, and Andrew was assigned a team to compete with the other cast members. It remains to be seen if Kendall ever makes an appearance during the show’s four-episode run Alex tapped Unwell producer Andrew Vetter to join the first episodeCredit: YouTube/Unwell The producer was sorted onto a team and seemed to click with his new castmembersCredit: YouTube/Unwell Comments
